'''TuMarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] working for an unknown crime lord. His boss, and that of another criminal, [[Slestack]] were rivals. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Slestack and TuMarr encountered each other on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], both attempting to capture [[Grik Sonosan]], an agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] taken to Dromund Kaas to be interrogated by [[Darth Baras]]. Baras' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] managed to manipulate the two criminals into fighting each other, giving the Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Lanklyn]] time to escape.

==Behind the scenes==
TuMarr is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
